gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the currently selected time tracking implementation for my Jira project so that I can ensure we are using the correct method for tracking time spent on tasks.
gold.ideal: The API should return the currently selected time tracking implementation, including details such as the name and configuration settings.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I need to update the time tracking implementation for our Jira instance to a new method that better suits our team's workflow.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully update the time tracking implementation and return a confirmation message along with the new configuration details.

gold.user: As a product owner, I want to see a list of all available time tracking implementations so that I can evaluate which one would be best for our project.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all available time tracking implementations, including their names and descriptions.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to access the shared time tracking configuration to ensure that all team members are aligned on how time is tracked across projects.
